entries.title: About Pulin
entries.body: Product manager who started as an engineer — a CS degree from Mumbai, three peer-reviewed machine learning papers, and an MS in Management Information Systems from Texas A&M sit underneath every roadmap. Equally comfortable in Postman and a Bitbucket pipeline as in Figma. Over the last four years: launched a cross-platform insurance app to 500K+ users, architected a multi-agent commerce platform as a founding product manager, and is now rebuilding the prompting and developer-platform layer behind an AI voice-agent product at HireEZ.

entries.title: A developer surface out of a fragmented internal wiki

dl.Problem: Sales GTM and Account Management at HireEZ had no fast way to answer "does the product support X" — every question routed through Product and Engineering.
dl.Approach: Built a custom MCP server on the internal integration dashboard, querying the master database and the markdown docs engineering keeps current, to surface live feature-support answers natively inside Claude.
dl.Impact: Turnaround on feature-support questions cut 93%, removing Product/Engineering as a bottleneck for GTM.

entries.title: Teaching agents to run a marketplace

dl.Problem: As founding PM at VYBD.AI (formerly BulkMagic), slow human research and manual seller operations needed to become automated systems — with no dedicated infra team.
dl.Approach: Architected a multi-agent AI Market Research Agent, orchestrated a micro-warehousing platform (supplier onboarding, KYC, shipment tracking), and connected agent workflows for catalog automation.
dl.Impact: Decision cycles cut from 6 months to 8 weeks at 85% accuracy; vendor onboarding 60% faster; manual operational gaps down 40%.

entries.title: Zero to one, at insurance scale

dl.Problem: Health, motor and travel insurance lived in disconnected legacy flows at ICICI Lombard — needed one cross-platform digital app without risking trust on live policies and claims.
dl.Approach: Rebuilt the payment gateway into a centralized, policy-linked system with automated reconciliation, phased the GTM per feature, and ran behavior-based A/B tests on cards and notifications.
dl.Impact: 500K+ users onboarded in 6 months, policy conversion up 22% (~$4.2M+ new premium), transaction failures down 18%.

entries.title: Designing for students who want to help, not search

dl.Problem: College students at Texas A&M wanted to volunteer but couldn’t find opportunities fitting their schedule or transportation — EventVol, a full HCI research project.
dl.Approach: Ran user interviews and affinity mapping, built personas and a journey map, then iterated mid-fidelity wireframes into a working Figma prototype with a full style guide.
dl.Impact: Shipped a validated end-to-end prototype covering discovery, transportation coordination and feedback.

entries.title: Archive — more work
entries.body: Sits directly after Selected work on the page, as the wider body of work those four case studies are drawn from. 37 files from undergrad and grad school, filed rather than deleted — each one now a short write-up of what it actually is, not just a link out: 11 product write-ups, one case study each for Hertz App Redesign, Apollo Urgent Care and EventVol, 13 presentations, and 10 Design Diary UX-teardown essays.
